description: H100 SXM-inspired pair; idealized NVLink bandwidth, synthetic latency, fixed compute times.
assumptions: Two endpoints with one FullyConnected dimension, not an eight-GPU HGX topology.
450 GB/s per direction is an idealized allocation of half the advertised 900 GB/s aggregate NVLink bandwidth to one peer.
500 ns link latency and 10-cycle endpoint delay are synthetic assumptions, not measured H100 timings.
3350 GB/s memory bandwidth and 989 TFLOPS dense BF16 are reference values only; roofline is disabled.
